source: User-supplied Unit D Science 24 textbook PDF in immutable Brightspace source archive
cropPolicy: Focused crops of original user-supplied textbook diagrams; each has a reading prompt, caption, and enlarge control. Mobile stacks figures with text.
cbeDisposition: The CBE 2020 supplementary images were visually compared; these figures were clearer for their lesson jobs, and CBE reuse rights were not established. No CBE images were copied.
